notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
description:
Activate Thrnoe of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature.
The artifact creature dies, triggering Dross Scorpion, untapping Throne of Geth.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
